body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

**Slice B-api** of qa#3's round 2 part B (`touched:ee9ad834` at 8e3d4a54, 82 of 174 items; B-browser files its own record, part A judges the rest). Per-clause tables follow as comments, one per runner group.


## Environment fingerprint

- framework objectstack-ai/objectstack **main @ 8e3d4a54** (`docs(skills, mcp): teach that an AI service account is refused a confirmation-gated action whatever it sends` #33057); `ui/` in the same tree, **no Console build** (every item in this slice is api / cli / build surface).
- Wave: qa#3 seat #33014, anchor #32908, round 2 part B (increment ee9ad834 → 8e3d4a54), maintainer 「跑」 relayed by triage#1 (comment 6848790965).
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (20 s) + `OS_SKIP_DTS=1 turbo build` of the showcase, CLI and dogfood closures (70 packages, 1 m 22 s, 0 cached). Node 22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, 4 CPUs, 15 GiB shared memory cgroup.
- App: stock showcase (`examples/app-showcase`) via `objectstack dev --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa3b/RUNNER/db/ITEM.db --no-compile --no-watch` with `OS_PORT=PORT`; one port range per runner (4710–4789, disjoint), at most one server per runner at a time. Scratch app copies (`$WS/examples/app-X` with `packages` and `node_modules` symlinked to the tree) for every CLI item, every package install, every self-pinging connector / external datasource boot and every boot that needed its own compile. The tree's `dist/objectstack.json` was never recompiled and its `.objectstack/installed-packages/` was never written (checked by the runners).
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) + the showcase's demo personas; runtime personas, keys, positions and permission sets minted per item through HTTP doors (named in each clause row).
- Execution: **parallel**, 8 runner subagents (opus, effort `high`) dispatched from this thread session: L1–L4 (Tier 1 by area), T2-A / T2-B (Tier 2), T3 (P2), X (the 7 items handed back from part A at 09:15Z, mixed tiers). Model tier from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived mandate, default opus.
- Wall-clock: setup 6 min (09:10–09:16: brief, selector, install, build, smoke boot) · testing 44 min wall (09:16–10:00, 8 parallel runners; each self-reported 5–13 min of its own setup) · verification 8 min (independent re-run of the release-blocker candidate at 8e3d4a54 and both probe defects at 18.3.0 83d7e4ae, a separate worktree build of 1 m 01 s). Cost at draft time: `get_session` `external_metadata.usage.cost_usd` = 82.77.
- Environment incident: the shared memory cgroup OOM-killed multi-file vitest runs (dogfood, runtime, cli, verify, plugin-auth) while 8 runners were live. Every killed run was re-run at `--maxWorkers=1` (dogfood one file per invocation); every re-run was green. No test failed; only processes were killed.

## Scope

Selector `touched:ee9ad834` resolved at 8e3d4a54 by `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs touched:ee9ad834 --json` → 174 runnable items (6 blocked hidden; 365 files changed in ee9ad834..8e3d4a54). This slice = `items-B-api.md`, 91 items: **82 judged here** (52 Tier 1 pinned, 20 Tier 2 manual, 10 P2 unpinned) and **9 judged in part A**. Every revision below is the one the resolver reported; all 82 matched the item JSON the runners read. No `planned` item is in this slice.

**Judged in part A (not scored here):** `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`, `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed`, `api-backend.query-contract-matrix`, `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch`, `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable`, `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` (all `priority:P0`, A-P0); `ai.mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction`, `api-backend.actions-namespace-address` (round 1 FAIL items of #32940, A-R1F); `studio-authoring.multi-package-item-rows` (cites `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` by exact path, A-FIX).

Scope note: part A's `file:` selectors for `platform-baseline-sets.ts` and `security-plugin-security-service.ts` match no item by exact path, so the resolver falls back to the directory `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src`. The seat and part A agreed at 09:15–09:16Z that part B scores those directory-level items. In this slice they are `access-security.owd-save-gate`, `suggested-binding-loop`, `packaged-flow-write-door-parity`, `parent-and-organization-write-guards`, `agent-ceiling-set-assignment-refusal`, `api-backend.route-ledger-live-parity` and `platform-core.serve-composition-v18`. Runner X ran them.

Method: Tier 1 ran every pin file named in each item's `automated.ref`, batched per package per runner, plus corroborating files. **All pins green at 8e3d4a54**, with one environment exception. The tsc block of `packages/qa/dogfood/test/rest-route-generation-tombstones.test.ts` (6 cases, control included) fails TS7016 on an `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` build because the spec package ships no `.d.ts`. That leg was driven by hand with tsc against the spec source and passed (Parked). Unit/integration totals: L1 1,257 · L2 ≈2,600 · L3 1,526 · L4 1,435 · X 221. Dogfood totals: L1 67 · L2 205 · L3 83 (1 skip by design) · L4 35 · X 59. Each clause was scored at the layer its pin reaches (RUNNER rule 6). Clauses whose oracle sits below the pin's layer were driven live, or recorded blocked with their fixture.

Per-clause tables: one file per runner group, `record-B-api-clauses-{L1,L2,L3,L4,X,T2-A,T2-B,T3}.md` (29–64 KB each; post one comment per file).

## Fails: reproduction rule and disposition

1. **api-backend.automation-namespace-address · A8 · product defect (low), already carded.**
   Repro: boot with any installed namespace (scratch copy + scratch package qa_b), as admin `DELETE /api/v1/automation/showcase/showcase_batch_reminders/runs` (no body).
   Expected (A8, ADR-0150 D5): the automation domain's 405, `Allow: GET`, dispatcher envelope `{success:false,error:{code:METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED,message:"Method not allowed",httpStatus:405}}`, the answer the bare `/automation/showcase_batch_reminders/runs` gives.
   Actual: the Hono transport's 405, `Allow: GET, HEAD`, envelope `{success:false,error:{code,message:"DELETE is not supported for … Allowed: GET, HEAD.",details:{method,path,allowed}}}`. POST and PUT behave the same, as does GET on `/automation/showcase/X/trigger` and `/automation/trigger/showcase/X`. Reproduced twice at 8e3d4a54, unchanged since ee9ad834 (no commit in the range touches automation-address.ts or the every-verb test). HEAD is served (200) on both paths, so the transport's Allow is not false; a ruling may instead re-spell A8.
   Disposition: product defect. **No new card:** the prior round's card-api-1 (filed by the seat in #33026–#33031) covers it.
2. **api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract · A2 · stale spec.**
   Repro (test oracle): `pnpm exec vitest run src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` in packages/rest, which is green. Its exact route-set rows show `metadata.endpoints.maintenance` removing 4 routes (`GET /meta/_drafts`, `GET /meta/diagnostics`, `POST /meta/_migrate-record-currency-codes`, `POST /meta/_migrate-stored`) and `item` removing 14 (steps[7]'s 13 + `GET /meta/:type/:ns/:name`).
   Expected per steps[6]/[7] and A2: 3 and 13. Both growths were ruled: the ADR-0144 ruling item B and ADR-0150 D5 (#31691).
   Disposition: stale spec → card-B-api-R1 item 1. Beside it, a low declaration lag in the spec's `item` describe() → card-B-api-5.
3. **api-backend.second-object-exposure-and-internal-fields · A0 · stale spec (ref).**
   Repro: `ls packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.data-door-internal-field-positions.test.ts` → absent at 8e3d4a54. bca2a515 (#32128) moved it to `packages/objectql/src/protocol-data-door-internal-field-positions.test.ts`, which is green.
   A0's own verify says a missing file is a stale ref, not a pass.
   Disposition: stale spec → card-B-api-R1 item 2.
4. **api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code · A2 · stale spec (repeat).**
   Repro: `pnpm exec vitest run test/error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts` in packages/qa/dogfood, which is green. `POST /api/v1/actions/errsent_contact/ACTION` with a patch repeating a taken `unique: true` email → 409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION, details `{developerMessage, field:'email', object}`.
   Expected per A2: exactly `{developerMessage, object}`.
   Disposition: stale spec since 28a15270 (#32935). The item is still rev 8. **No new card:** it is item 2 of the prior round's card-api-R1 (#33032), not yet landed.
5. **cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts · A1 (controlled_by_parent arm) · stale spec.**
   Repro: blank `defineStack` scaffold with object `qv_line {sharingModel:'controlled_by_parent', fields:{item:{type:'master_detail', reference:'qv_item'}}}`, with `required` omitted (and again with `required:false`). `os validate --json` → exit 0 `{"valid":true}`; `os build` → exit 0. Reproduced twice. Traps ruled out: the arm took effect (stats.fields 4→5, and the compiled qv_line carries the master_detail with `required:false`).
   The parse admits this shape on purpose: #30905 ruling A treats the object's only master_detail, declared or defaulted to `required:false`, as an optional master. The refused shapes fail as expected: no master_detail (STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID at objects.1.sharingModel), and two required masters, including through objectExtensions (STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID at objectExtensions.0.fields). The item's pin is an `os lint` rule, which validate and build do not run.
   Disposition: stale spec → card-B-api-R1 item 3.

6. integration-system.external-datasource-federated-read · probe beside the clauses · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM.

**No release blocker:** no P0 item is in this slice (part A holds them). The one candidate raised to the seat at 10:00Z, card-B-api-1, reproduces identically at 18.3.0 (83d7e4ae), so it is not a regression.

## Parked-on #32908 (checklist accuracy and fixture gaps; not extracted)

**Stale or wrong item text, no verdict moved:**
- `access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers` steps[2]–[4] and N2: the package-less PUT the steps describe now answers 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE (ADR-0146 D11), and the pin saves into the `.custom` pair. Re-point the steps at the RUNNER customization-pair recipe.
- `access-security.security-catalog-activation-and-clone-doors` A4 names the refusal `not-held-by-qualifier`. The wire carries RESOURCE_CONFLICT, the sentence and `details.candidates`, with no such tag.
- `identity-auth.ai-service-account-register-and-key` steps[3] / A3: a fresh account's key answers 403 on every data read under the agent ceiling (ADR-0151 D3). The "ran as" proof must be the credential_use audit row or the ban/unban toggle.
- `ai.mcp-http-surface` variants[1]: data:write alone serves create/update/delete_record and create_upload_link, not delete_records. metadata:write alone answers JSON-RPC -32601 rather than an empty list.
- `ai.mcp-validate-expression`: `inScope.fields` lists the hidden `__search` companion and `record.__search` validates OK. Introspection surfaces a column that search.field-scoped-narrowing A2 calls invisible (names only, no values). Flag for the search/MCP owners.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

Every item got a probe line in its group file (1–4 min each, ≈2.5 h of runner time in total), on the same boots and personas as its clauses. Doors probed: the activation door (body shapes, member, anon), public form (unknown slug, forged owner/org keys), search (`$searchFields` case, padding, union; `objects=` blanks, duplicates, member-403 objects; `perObject` bounds; wildcard), MCP (OAuth issuer on private hosts, dataset limit/measures, faces), the REST config switches, bulk / batch / data doors (empty and missing ids, empty headers), automation addressed paths (every verb), package install/overwrite/restart, the clone door, the seed door, the codemod range edges, the hook-body lint spellings, datasource and connector admin doors, approvals (unknown field approver), and attachments (count/aggregate). Boundary classes: empty string, missing id, unknown id, wrong verb, opposite posture (member vs admin, anonymous), restart durability.

Findings extracted: card-B-api-1 (activation self-lockout), card-B-api-2 (OAuth issuer), card-B-api-3 (drillRawRows), card-B-api-4 (package restart rollback).
